# SENO Avian Genetic Test — aviantestpro.com

> Bird DNA testing laboratory services: avian gender (sex) determination, viral PCR screening, parentage and DNA fingerprinting, plus lab-building and agent programmes. Reports are issued from a molecular diagnostics laboratory with 15 years of experience.

## Core services
- [Avian Gender DNA Test](https://aviantestpro.com/avian-gender-dna-test/): CHD-gene based sex determination from feather, blood or swab samples.
- [Avian Virus RT-PCR Test](https://aviantestpro.com/avian-virus-rt-pcr-test/): Molecular screening for PBFD, avian polyomavirus, PPMV and other avian pathogens.
- [Racing Pigeon Performance DNA Test](https://aviantestpro.com/racing-pigeon-performance-dna-test/): Genetic markers associated with performance traits in racing pigeons.
- [Pigeon DNA Fingerprinting](https://aviantestpro.com/pigeon-dna-fingerprinting/): Individual identity and parentage verification for racing pigeons.
- [Avian DNA Test Kits](https://aviantestpro.com/avian-dna-test-kits/): Sample collection kits for breeders and clinics.
- [Build an Avian DNA Test Lab](https://aviantestpro.com/build-avian-dna-test-lab/): Turnkey laboratory setup and training.
- [Become an Agent](https://aviantestpro.com/become-an-agent/): Regional distribution and referral programme.

## Laboratory quality & validation
- [Avian Testing Laboratory Quality & Validation](https://aviantestpro.com/avian-testing-laboratory-quality-validation/): How to evaluate avian laboratory methods, PCR validation, controls, traceability and reporting.
- [How to Evaluate an Avian DNA Testing Laboratory](https://aviantestpro.com/evaluate-avian-dna-testing-laboratory/): Due-diligence sequence and weighted scorecard for comparing providers.
- [PCR Assay Validation for Avian Samples](https://aviantestpro.com/pcr-assay-validation-avian-samples/): Intended use, sample matrix, acceptance criteria and validation records.
- [Analytical vs Diagnostic Sensitivity in Avian PCR](https://aviantestpro.com/analytical-vs-diagnostic-sensitivity/): Why a detection limit is not a diagnostic accuracy claim.
- [PCR Positive and Negative Controls in Avian Testing](https://aviantestpro.com/pcr-positive-negative-controls/): Control types, run acceptance and invalid batches.
- [Sample Traceability and Chain of Custody in DNA Testing](https://aviantestpro.com/sample-traceability-chain-of-custody-dna-testing/): Identifiers, record linkage and custody limits.
- [Failed Avian DNA Tests](https://aviantestpro.com/failed-avian-dna-tests/): Failure categories, investigation and repeat policy.
- [What a Bird DNA Test Report Should Contain](https://aviantestpro.com/bird-dna-test-report/): Report elements, terminology and amendment control.
- [Laboratory Accreditation vs Quality Certification](https://aviantestpro.com/laboratory-accreditation-vs-quality-certification/): ISO/IEC 17025, ISO 9001, scope and verification.
- [Evaluating Avian DNA Testing Suppliers and Kits](https://aviantestpro.com/avian-dna-testing-supplier-evaluation/): Validation evidence, lot consistency and support.
- [Quality Control in High-Volume Avian Testing](https://aviantestpro.com/quality-control-high-volume-avian-testing/): Batch design, contamination control, review and KPIs.

## Languages
English, Arabic, Japanese, Korean, Spanish, French, German — each with its own hreflang-annotated URL prefix (`/ar/`, `/ja/`, `/ko/`, `/es/`, `/fr/`, `/de/`).

## Notes
- Results are laboratory reports, not veterinary diagnosis; clinical interpretation belongs to the attending veterinarian.
- Sample collection guidance is published per test; incorrect sampling is the most common cause of an inconclusive result.
